'''Plo Koon''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] who became a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and a lifetime member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], holding the position from after the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] to the end of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Koon served as a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], leading soldiers in campaigns, fighting on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and at [[Kaliida Shoals/Legends|Kaliida Shoals]] amongst others. Koon was also an accomplished [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].

Koon had an [[Plo Koon's uncle|uncle]] and a niece, [[Sha Koon]], who were each also members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Sha, his niece, served as a personal communicator between the Jedi strike force and the rest of the Republic during the Stark Hyperspace War. He was a close friend of fellow Masters [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] (whom he fought alongside during the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]]), [[Micah Giiett]], [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and noted fighter pilot [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]].

Plo Koon was shot down over [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] by his [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone troopers]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] him in compliance with [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|You always were the most humble, polite, stubborn, and ''difficult'' Padawan, Plo.|translated=1|Tyvokka|<ref name="Stark Hyperspace War" />}}
[[File:PloKoonUnmasked-STD.jpg|thumb|left|125px|Koon without his breathing mask on Dorin]]
Native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]], homeworld of the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Species/Legends|species]], Koon was accustomed to breathing in an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] containing little [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], forcing him<ref name="DB" /> to wear an [[Antiox breath mask/Legends|antiox breath mask]] when abroad. Born into a [[Koon family|family]] strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Koon's own [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] was discovered early and he was turned over to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] early on in his infancy for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]]. Like his [[Plo Koon's uncle|uncle]] before him, Koon was trained at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi academy|academy]] for most of his childhood years, eventually passing the [[Initiate Trials/Legends|Initiate Trials]] and becoming eligible to be selected as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. Selected by the esteemed [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tyvokka/Legends|Tyvokka]], Koon had a reputation for making quick and clear distinctions between right and wrong. Often taking swift, decisive action with little or no thought of repercussions; this attitude, combined with Koon's sarcastic wit, often tried the patience of his Jedi Master.<ref name="Stark Hyperspace War" />

Eventually Koon's niece, [[Sha Koon]], was also discovered to be eligible for training and was inducted into the Order. While not shirking the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] rules of attachment, they did have a meaningful relationship, sharing insights with each other and forming a strong bond. After years of study with Master Tyvokka, Koon was ready to take the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]], eventually completing them successfully and being [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|elevated]] to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] by the High Council.

===Jedi Knight===
{{Quote|Fame, recognition—a Jedi does not seek these things. It was enough to serve and have good come from that.|Plo Koon|<ref name="Stark Hyperspace War" />}}
Remaining close with his former master, Koon studied as a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]] independently, taking on missions that often required that he demonstrate his skill with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], rather than diplomacy.<ref name="Stark Hyperspace War" /> Additionally, Koon would return to his homeworld at some point in his career, studying the ways of the [[Baran Do]] and earning a place in their order.<ref name="Outcast" /> After years of hard work and service, Koon's former master approached him with an offer to join the ranks of the High Council. Humbly declining in favor of a stronger mind, like that of his friend [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], Jedi Koon did accept a mission that Tyvokka was leading on the world of [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]]. [[File:TyvokkaDeath.jpg|thumb|273x273px|Plo Koon at his master's side as he passes away.]]
Acting as [[Jedi Diplomat|diplomats]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Koon and the other Jedi were to negotiate peace between the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Iaco Stark/Legends|Iaco Stark]]. Stark had been stealing [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] supplies from cargo vessels and selling them at lower prices than the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] could afford to offer, forcing the Federation to petition the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to intervene on their behalf.<ref name="Stark Hyperspace War" />However, some factions in the government wanted more decisive action, and they organized an attack on Stark's forces, which caused the negotiations to degenerate into a firefight. Plo Koon watched in disbelief as Tyvokka was killed in the crossfire. Koon was by his master's side as he died, Koon devastated by his loss. [[File:Stark_Hyperspace_War_by_John_Van_Fleet.jpg|thumb|210x210px|Plo Koon fighting alongside Luminara Unduli during the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]]|left]]

===Stark Hyperspace War===
After his master's death in 44 BBY, Koon rallied the forces of the Republic and led them to a miraculous victory in the ensuing conflict with fellow Jedi [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], which came to be known as the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]]. The Republic won the war, and this triumph made Plo Koon a hero of the Republic. During the battle, Koon befriended a Republic soldier named [[Jace Dallin]], who later spoke of Koon's bravery and humility during the war.<ref name="Stark Hyperspace War" />

===Jedi High Council===
{{Quote|A Jedi does not ''cling'' to sorrow, young Padawan. We accept it. Sorrow is a part of life as well as joy. There are gifts to be found, even in death and sorrow…''strange gifts''. We accept this, we learn, and we go on.|Koon, to [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]|<ref name="Stark Hyperspace War" />}}
Following his decisive victory over Iaco Stark, Plo Koon was promoted to the rank of Jedi Master and was given a life-time seat on the Jedi High Council in honor of his Master's dying wish.<ref name="Stark Hyperspace War" /> While on the Council, Koon formed a very close friendship with fellow Council member [[Micah Giiett]] and went on many adventures with him. Their constant verbal sparring made them appear as rivals, but those close to the two Jedi Masters understood that they were indeed good friends.<ref name="jcaow">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War]]''</ref>

{{Talesstart}}
Giiett and Koon were responsible for the release of the chef [[Slabba Drewl]] from the clutches of [[Corpo (Hutt)|Corpo]] the Hutt on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. In a cooking contest with Corpo's kitchen droid [[MREM-02]], Giiett was able to distract the audience while Koon swapped the droid's ingredients with volatile substances such as [[Rakririan Burnout Sauce]]. When judged, Giiett's [[Squirmer Stew]], though average, was enough to win the competition and release Drewl.
{{Talesend}}

[[File:PloDiscoversAhsoka.png|thumb|right|250px|Plo Koon discovers Ahsoka Tano.]]
During a mission to [[Shili/Legends|Shili]], Plo Koon found an infant, Force-sensitive [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] named [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Taking her to the Temple for training, he kept an eye on her progression through the academy, nicknaming her "Little Soka" and maintaining a close bond with her.<ref name="rm">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> By the time of the [[Yinchorri Uprising]], Koon took a permanent seat on the [[Council of Reconciliation/Legends|Council of Reconciliation]] with [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]].<ref name="dreadnaughtsofrendili">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Dreadnaughts of Rendili]]''</ref> During the uprising in the [[Yinchorri system]], Masters Koon and Giiett led a party of Jedi in search of the [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] rebels' secret base of operations. Finding nothing on [[Yibikkoror]]'s [[Yibikkoror floating city|floating city]], the team met up with the other two groups on [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]]. With Jedi [[Lilit Twoseas]] and Padawan [[K'Kruhk]] fighting alongside Koon, the Kel Dor Jedi agreed to get the other Jedi offworld while a dying Master Giiett sacrificed himself during their escape.<ref name="jcaow" /> In honor of his fallen friend, Koon took over the training of Giiett's Padawan, [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]] and eventually saw her rise to the rank of Knight.<ref name="potj" />

When the High Council discovered that the terrorist group known as the [[Jin'ha]] were synthesizing [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] ore on the planet [[Obredaan]], Masters Koon and Eeth Koth were [[First mission to Obredaan|dispatched]] to investigate and put an end to the production of the illegal substance. After their [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Obredaan)|transport]] was destroyed, the two Masters were captured; the Council immediately [[Second mission to Obredaan|sent]] Master Qui-Gon Jinn and his Padawan [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] when they lost communications with the two Councilors. Master Jinn was able to locate the Masters in a holding facility and released them, joining his Padawan at the synthesizing facility to defeat the terrorists there. After the fighting and the destruction of the facility, Koon joined his comrades in witnessing a [[Trade Federation gunship]] fly over the planet, suggesting a link between the Jin'Ha and the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Koon later had a training duel with Kenobi in the Jedi Temple, with Kenobi proving successful.<ref name="SW:OW" /><nowiki/>

====Battle of Naboo====
[[File:PloKoonEpisodeI.jpg|thumb|220x220px|Koon on the Jedi Council during the Naboo Crisis.]]
While one of the High Council's most valued members for his knowledge and combat experience, Koon remained silent at most meetings; rarely joining in debates and simply listening to the deep discussions of his peers. During this time, Koon took on the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] Padawan [[Lissarkh]], training her in the ways of the Force. Plo Koon was present when his friend Master Jinn reported his suspicions that the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] of the past were not extinct as once thought, but rather in hiding and preparing to reveal themselves. Additionally, Jinn claimed to have discovered a vergence in the Force, the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]] of prophecy: [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The Council was skeptical of the boy's suitability, and Jinn's usual headstrong attitude did nothing to help matters. Before the Council came to a final decision, Jinn was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|killed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by a [[Darth Maul/Legends|Zabrak assassin]] whose training in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] made Jinn's assertion of the return of the Sith incontrovertible. Traveling to Naboo with half the Council for [[Funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Jinn's funeral]], Koon and the other Councilors allowed Skywalker to be trained as a favor to Jinn's memory.<ref name="TPM" />

====Negotiations on Malastare====
Shortly after the Battle of Naboo, Plo Koon traveled with fellow Jedi High Council members [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]], [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]], [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and Mundi's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] to [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] to negotiate a truce between the [[Lannik (species)/Legends|Lannik]] royals and a terrorist group known as the [[Red Iaro/Legends|Red Iaro]]. He gave A'Sharad Hett some advice on how he could spend time by looking at the artwork that was all around them. After the first meeting the Jedi were offered a lift back to their quarters by the Lannik adviser called [[Hutar Zash]]. Zash and the Lannik pilots unexpectedly turned on the Jedi and attempted to kill them. After defeating them, Yaddle flew them down to Windu, Gallia and Piell who were falling through a podrace. The Jedi speculated that the terrorists planned to kill the Lannik Prince and made for his building. They crashed through the building just before the Prince was eaten by an [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dog]]. Plo Koon attempted to stop the Red Iaro leader, [[Myk'chur Finux Zug]], but he activated his jetpack and flew through the hole the Jedi had made when they crash landed; however, he was instantly killed by a podracer.<ref name="Emissaries to Malastare">''[[Star Wars: Emissaries to Malastare]]''</ref>

Partnering with Master Gallia, Plo Koon accompanied [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]] Mace Windu to the world of [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]] in order to rescue Jedi [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]. Vos, who had been sent to stop a powerful [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] called [[Volfe Karkko]] weeks before, had lost contact with the Temple and in apparent need of rescue. Warned off by [[Sheyf]] [[Tinté Vos]], the Jedi landed none the less and were relieved to find Vos victorious after his confrontation with the [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] Dark Jedi.<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Darkness">''[[Star Wars: Darkness]]''</ref>

===Separatist Crisis===
{{Quote|Few issues would carry the import of creating a Republic army. The Senators are anxious and afraid, and believe that no vote will ever be more important than this one now before him.|Plo Koon, on the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]]|<ref name="AOTC novel">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars:'' Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
Plo Koon remained on the High Council for the next decade, witnessing a growing public discontent with the galactic government and the Jedi Order. A splinter group known as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] emerged, led by a former Jedi who had now taken the name [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="HN 51">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|jediwatch/13411_1.html|Activists Deface Jedi Temple Lobby}}</ref> During this [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Koon and fellow Jedi [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]] advised the highest levels of the Republic, including Chancellor Palpatine himself, in dealing with the troubling times. Both Jedi tried to help Palpatine in managing the crisis.<ref name="Forceful">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/12/imageattack20031202.html|series=Image Attack|text=Forceful Advisors}}</ref> At the same time, a group calling itself the [[People's Inquest]] began enlisting support for a motion that would have forced the Jedi Order to be more accountable to the government. Plo Koon himself was forced to defend the Temple from the group, [[Mind trick/Legends|persuading]] them to disperse after a minor incident in the public atrium.<ref name="HN 51">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|jediwatch/13411_1.html|Activists Deface Jedi Temple Lobby}}</ref>

When an assassination attempt on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] life caused an uproar in the Senate, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] held a meeting with representatives of the High Council and the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]]—a meeting which Koon attended alongside Masters Windu, [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and her Padawan, [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]. Soon after, Koon was present to receive a coded message from Obi-Wan Kenobi, who was trapped on the world of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and taken captive by the leaders of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. This act set in motion a series of events that would lead to the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref>

===Clone Wars ([[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]–[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]])===
{{Quote|My only weapon is the Force!|Plo Koon|<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref>}}
====Battle of Geonosis====
Accompanying Master Windu to Geonosis as part of a massive [[Jedi assault team/Legends|task force]] of Jedi, the group charged across the plains of Geonosis to [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|rescue]] Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Anakin Skywalker, and Senator Padmé Amidala. Dueling his way through legions of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] at the [[Petranaki arena]], Koon joined with Ki-Adi-Mundi and several other Jedi in raiding the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] that appeared to control all of the droids on the planet. Unfortunately for them, the CIS had a backup control device, and Koon and Mundi were captured. They were marched to the execution arena where the surviving Jedi awaited a seemingly imminent death. Koon was rescued from certain death by the newly discovered [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], a secret [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] army developed for the Republic without the authorisation of the Senate or the High Council. Plo Koon would rally his new troops on the fields outside the arena, leading them into the first battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="aotc" />

====Brentaal IV====
[[File:Cw_plokoon.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Koon dispatches a [[cold assault battle droid]] on Brentaal IV.]]Returning to the Temple on Coruscant to beginning planning war strategy and military movements, Koon was made a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] with in the Grand Army and given control of a fleet of ships. One of his most distinctive early commands was the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Clone Wars)|Battle]] of [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], where he advised [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]] from orbit, leading the Republic to victory over [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Shogar Tok]].<ref name="shaak ti">''[[Jedi: Shaak Ti]]''</ref> Serving alongside Master Gallia on many early missions, they rescued Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] from pirates<ref name="deadends">[[Republic 61|''Republic'' 61]]</ref> and aided Jedi Skywalker and Master Mundi in locating Master Kenobi and [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17]] on [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]].<ref name="nomansland">[[Republic 62|''Republic'' 62]]</ref>

Early in the war, Koon and fellow High Council member [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] encountered the bounty hunter [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] while attempting to quell an inmate uprising at a galactic prison. Temporarily sealing Durge in the catacombs beneath the prison with the help of one of the inmates, the Jedi bargained with their new found comrade. For his cooperation in helping in the ending of the riots, the Jedi would petition for his early release and the lessening of the sentences of those prisoners who accommodated the Jedi.<ref name="meansandends">{{CWACite|6|Means and Ends}}</ref>

Serving as chief negotiator during the [[Battle of Rendili]], Koon was monitored by Masters [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Anakin Skywalker. Koon was joined by Captain [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] when he boarded a [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]] [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Dreadnaught]] to open peace talks with his old comrade, Jace Dallin. During the negotiations Lieutenant [[Mellor Yago]] of the [[Rendili Home Defense Fleet]] arrived along with a security force to take command, placing Dallin, Koon and Dodonna under arrest. Because Yago was planning to turn the Republic fleet over to the Separatists, Master Tiin was prepared to open fire on all of the Dreadnaughts to prevent them from falling into enemy hands. However, Jedi Skywalker was able to lead a crippling attack against the fleet until Masters Kenobi and Vos could rescue the captive Republic officers and Jedi and kill Yago and his men, taking the ships for the Republic.<ref name="dreadnaughtsofrendili" />

====Battle of Gwori====
[[File:Gwori_system.png|thumb|186x186px|Koon assissts the Jedi during the Battle of Gwori.]]
Along with Master Tiin, Koon commanded the Republic armada during the [[Battle of Gwori]]. Koon and Tiin waited above the planet while Skywalker, Kenobi and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] led a command unit of clone troopers to infiltrate [[Gwori]]'s tight security system and pinpoint the location of their Separatist ship production facilities. When Tano commed in the location of their target, Koon and Tiin undertook a previously unperformed maneuver: a hyperspace jump in-between the Separatist fleets and the planet below. Stunningly, they executed the move with no casualties and successfully destroyed the Separatist facilities in a series of runs, rescuing Skywalker, Kenobi and Tano in the process.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom">''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]''</ref>

====The ''Malevolence'' crisis====
{{Quote|When you ask for trouble, you should not be surprised when it finds you.|Plo Koon|audio=PloKoonProverb-RM.flac|<ref name="rm" />}}
[[File:PloKoonAndWolffe-RM.png|thumb|250px|Plo Koon discovers the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].|left]]
In 22 BBY, Plo Koon later led a patrol fleet of three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] to discover an unknown Separatist super weapon that had killed many fleets of cruisers and left no survivors. During the [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|Battle of Abregado]], the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], wiped out his patrol fleet leaving the Kel Dor, [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]], [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Sinker/Legends|Sinker]] and [[Boost/Legends|Boost]] trapped in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. Koon and the survivors held off the "[[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|Pod Hunter]]" that destroyed all other pods, and were picked up by Skywalker and Tano in the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] after Tano, drawing on her close friendship with Master Koon, was able to sense his life force amongst the debris. After being rescued, the group managed to evade a wave from the deadly [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannon]] of the ''Malevolence'', and Koon united with Skywalker's fleet and prepared the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|counterattack]] on the Separatist warship.<ref name="rm" />

As Anakin Skywalker led his starfighter squadron through the dangerous [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]] of the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]], Koon realized too late the peril they were in as a flock of [[Neebray/Legends|Neebray mantas]] posed a threat to their ships. Losing several starfighters, the group made it out and arrived at their destination ahead of the ''Malevolence''. Losing half their squadron to the ship's ion cannon, Koon and Tano were able to persuade a stubborn Skywalker into attacking the ship's [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]], causing it to misfire and destroy itself, leaving the endangered [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|medical center]] in the clear. As reinforcements arrived, Koon met up with the Republic ships and watched as the ''Malevolence'' was eventually destroyed.<ref name="dm">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref>

Later, Plo Koon would help the Jedi fight off the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], who had formed an alliance with the Confederacy. He was instrumental in destroying the battle cruiser, the ''[[Devastation]]'', upon which he dueled [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] alongside Padawan Ahsoka Tano.<ref name="JA">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance]]''</ref>

====Juma 9====
[[File:Teska_explosions.jpg|thumb|220x220px|Plo Koon and Obi-Wan Kenobi prepare to attack Kul Teska on Juma 9.]]
Master Koon coincidentally met with Obi-Wan Kenobi onboard the [[Juma 9]] station, but when it came under [[Battle of Juma 9|attack]] by Separatist forces, the two raced across the station to the hangar bay, and then to the core of the station to prevent it from being bombed by the droids. The two soon went to the control room where they faced the leader of the droid forces, [[Kul Teska]]. After a brief confrontation with Teska, they forced his retreat, at the expense of their lightsabers which they found hurtling through space.

Soon after that, Mace Windu and Kit Fisto arrived in time to save them from their predicament.

====Mission to Khorm====
{{Quote|In my ''many'' years, I've never seen the galaxy in such a state of brutal unrest. There will be many dark days yet, but we must keep hope alive.|Plo Koon|<ref name="In Service of the Republic" />}}
[[File:Ventress_vs._Plo_Koon.jpg|left|thumb|220x220px|Ventress attacks Plo Koon on Khorm.]]
Master Koon led Republic forces alongside with Master Kit Fisto, [[Wolffe/Legends|Clone Commander Wolffe]] and [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Major Kendal Ozzel]] on the planet [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]] in a mission to free the enslaved [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] people from the invading Separatists and their battle droids. Fighting alongside Khormai resistance forces, Koon was reluctant to sacrifice the clones in a direct assault on a vital strategic mine and therefore decided to destroy the weather-control station to lessen the amount of casualties.
[[File:CloneWarsPart7.jpg|thumb|204x204px|Koon during the Battle of Khorm]]
On their way up to the weather-control station, Count Dooku's Dark Acolyte, Asajj Ventress ambushed Koon and brought down an avalanche on top of him, wounding Koon and breaking his left arm. Despite his injury, Koon still maintained a willingness to continue the mission and eventually faced off against Ventress again later on in the mission. Fighting only with his right arm, Koon was able to withstand Ventress's Dark Side attacks - even managing to successfully land his own Force Push - and he ultimately prevented the Dark Jedi from destroying the mine by Force-pushing her detonator away, destroying it.<ref name="In Service of the Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: In Service of the Republic]]''</ref> Koon and Fisto fought off the invading battle droids and liberated the Khormai from the Separatists, letting them live free of fear again.

====First Battle of Felucia====
[[File:Plo_Koon_piloting.png|thumb|left|250px|Master Plo leads his squadron during the [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|First Battle of Felucia]].]]
Later, Koon took part in the [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|defense of Felucia]]. On-planet, the Republic forces led by Master Kenobi and Jedi Skywalker were being steadily driven back to the point that it was urgent that they retreat. While Republic starships engaged Separatist cruisers, Koon led fighters down to the planet to provide a means of transport off-world. After the successful retreat, Plo Koon sat in on the High Council meeting and heard of Ahsoka Tano's reckless actions during the battle. The Council quickly decided that the Padawan needed time away from the battlefield and would benefit from acting as a guard of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] for a time.<ref name="HH">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref>

Following [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] break in, Koon was present in hologram form within one of the Temple's comm centers when General Grievous transmitted a message, gloating to the Jedi over his capture of Councilor [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]]. While the Jedi discussed battle plans, Commander Wolffe reported to the Jedi Master that he had found a series of hand codes that Koth had planted on the recorded transmission. Reporting on these findings, the Council dispatched Masters Gallia, Kenobi, and Jedi Skywalker to rescue Koth and return him to the Temple from the [[Saleucami system/Legends|Saleucami system]].<ref name="GI">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref>

====The hunt for Boba Fett====
[[File:KoonFettOhnaka.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Plo Koon leads a captured Boba Fett to Hondo Ohnaka.]]
Following the [[Sabotage of the Endurance/Legends|sabotage]] of the [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']] by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], Koon was briefing the High Council in a data room within the Jedi Temple when the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] interrupted with a message. Playing a hologram which showed that Mace Windu and Skywalker were badly wounded and stranded on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]], Koon and Padawan Ahsoka Tano left for the planet to rescue the two Jedi. Following the rescue mission, the Temple received a message from [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], the bounty hunter holding a group of Republic soldiers hostage, warning them to come and find them.<ref name="R2 Come Home">{{TCW|R2 Come Home}}</ref> Once more accompanied by Tano, Koon descended into the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant Underworld]] looking for [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] old compatriots in order to track down Sing.<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref>

After a string of unsuccessful bar investigations, Tano discovered that Sing had recently killed her companion [[Castas/Legends|Castas]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. Despite being forced to fight their way out of the establishment, she and Koon had a solid lead and made a beeline for the planet. When they arrived, they were greeted by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], who warned them of a trap inside. Koon went first, to find Aurra Sing at a table. Koon sat down, and Fett came in behind him and pulled a gun on him. He was surprised to find him there, and not Windu, but was even more surprised when Tano came and held her lightsaber to Sing's throat. Sing kicked the table at Koon, and shot at Tano, who blocked it. Sing dashed away, and Tano chased after. Fett tried to escape, but Koon caught him. He asked Fett where the hostages were, but he refused to answer. Koon brought him to Ohnaka, who convinced him to reveal the information. Transmitting the information to his Padawan companion, Koon was able to see the hostages freed, [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and Fett captured, and [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] go down to her "death" in the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]. He then brought Fett back to Coruscant and put in the prison there.<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" />

Koon was present at the Temple when [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] brought back the remains of [[Halsey/Legends|Master Halsey]] and his Padawan [[Knox/Legends|Knox]] from the [[Devaron massacre/Legends|massacre]] on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. Koon surmised that there was a new [[Savage Opress/Legends|threat]], possibly a newly appointed [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].<ref name="Witches of the Mist">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>

====Battle of Lola Sayu====
[[File:KoonBriefing-Citadel.png|thumb|left|250px|Koon leads the briefing on the mission to the Citadel.]]
When Master [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] was [[Capture of Even Piell/Legends|captured]] by the CIS and held at [[The Citadel (episode)|the Citadel]] fortress on [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]], Master Koon briefed Jedi Kenobi, Skywalker and their clone officers on their [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|mission]]: rescue Master Piell before he could be forced to give up the coordinates of the [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]]. After the briefing Master Plo, went to the hangar tinkering with his starfighter. Ahsoka Tano came to him, telling Master Koon that it should be her choice to go, not her master's. Master Koon yielded little comfort to her, knowing that she must respect her master's wishes.<ref name="The Citadel">{{TCW|The Citadel (episode)}}</ref> Master Plo waited in the Jedi temple's war room with master Yoda and Windu for a message from Skywalker's and Kenobi's team. When they received from Kenobi about their means of escape being destroyed, master Plo told Kenobi and Skywalker that he would be on his way to rescue them.<ref name="Counterattack">{{TCW|Counterattack}}</ref>

[[File:Plo_Koon_and_wolfpack_members.png|thumb|246x246px|Koon, Wolffe and his clone troopers prepare to rescue the trapped Jedi on Lola Sayu.]]
Master Koon, along with fellow council member, Adi Gallia, Saesee Tiin, and Kit Fisto went with the rescue fleet. When the fleet reached the [[Lola Sayu system/Legends|system]], Master Koon and [[Wolffe/Legends|Commander Wolffe]], aboard Koon's [[Plo's Bros/Legends|gunship]], went through blockade protecting the planet while being protected the other Jedi with him in their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|star fighters]]. Koon was successful in extracting Kenobi's and Skywalker's team from the surface. Koon's gunship was able to make it back to the Republic, and Koon then ordered Admiral [[Coburn/Legends|Coburn]] to retreat back to Coruscant. When Kenobi's and Skywalker's team made it back to the Jedi Temple, Anakin asked him if he allowed Ahsoka to come along on the mission. Master Koon covered Ahsoka's claim that he did permit her to join the mission.<ref name="Citadel Rescue">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref>

====Second Battle of Felucia====
{{Quote|What is Ahsoka's strength?''"<br />"''She is fearless.''"<br />"''That can also be a weakness. Is she a worthy apprentice?''"<br />"''No one has her kind of determination.''"<br />"''Except you.''"<br />"''I'll find her.''"<br />"''This may not be within your power.|Plo Koon trying to reason with Jedi Skywalker after his Padawan's disappearance|<ref name="Padawan Lost">{{TCW|Padawan Lost}}</ref>}}
[[File:BattleOfFelucia-Planning.jpg|left|thumb|256x256px|Koon, Skywalker and Tano prepare to attack the Separatist stronghold on Felucia.]]
Later in the war, Master Koon [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|returned]] to Felucia along with clone Commander Wolffe, Anakin Skywalker, [[Rex/Legends|Captain Rex]], and Padawan Ahsoka Tano. Determined to destroy a large outpost reinforced by General Grievous and the Separatists, Koon devised a plan that would see the fortress completely crippled. Leading a section of Koon's [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] in flanking maneuvers, Padawan Tano led her team in tandem with Jedi Skywalker's in scaling the walls of the Separatist outpost while their [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] and [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|Juggernaut assault tanks]] heavily opened fire on the main structure, which destroyed it after several shots.<ref name="Padawan Lost" /> [[File:PloKoonFelucia-PL.png|thumb|250px|Plo Koon during the Second Battle of Felucia]]
When the outpost eventually fell under Koon's leadership, Padawan Tano was abducted by several Trandoshan hunters during the siege, and taken off the planet to the [[Trandosha/Legends|Doshan]] moon [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]]. Ordering his forces to cease in their efforts to find the Togrutan Jedi Padawan, Koon pulled out of the mission and returned to the Jedi Temple. Master Koon assured Skywalker that their other forces and their intelligence would notify them if Tano was found.<ref name="Padawan Lost" /> Tano worked closely with other captive prisoners on Wasskah, and fought their way out of the prison they were being held in. They were then picked up by Koon and Skywalker who were waiting for them after being notified of they were rediscovered.

====Rescuing Adi Gallia====
After that, Master Koon was dispatched by the Jedi Council, with Commander [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]] helped to free Jedi Master Adi Gallia from the clutches of [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous]] after he boarded her ship, took her hostage and then made her his prisoner on his Separatist ship.

[[File:GalliaRescued-ND.png|thumb|240px|Koon rescues Gallia from Grievous's destroyer.]]
Koon and Wolffe boarded Grievous' ship shortly after, destroyed the attacking battle droids, and freed Gallia, although Grievous escaped from them. Koon then found [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and R2-D2 on board Grievous' ship too who had been on adventures of their own. Koon mischievously left the bickering droids with Commander Wolffe as he continued to eliminate the droids.<ref name="Nomad Droids">{{TCW|Nomad Droids}}</ref>

====Mission to Kadavo====
Koon, along with Admiral [[Coburn/Legends|Coburn]], [[Warthog/Legends|Warthog]] and Commander Wolffe, went to the [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Kadavo slave processing facility]] to help Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano free the [[Togruta/Legends|Togrutan]] colonists from the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] Slavers on [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]].<ref name="Escape from Kadavo (Ep.)">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref> However, although they were initially halted by the facility's ray shields, Skywalker was able to destroy the defensive towers. Meanwhile, Tano devised a plan in which the Republic forces evacuated everyone onto Admiral Coburn's ''Arquitens''-class light star cruiser. Koon and the Republic strike team then destroyed the slave facility, with it's destruction dealing a crippling blow to the Zygerrian slave trade.

[[File:TCW_Kadavo_Wolf_Leader.png|left|thumb|220x220px|Koon during the assault on Kadavo.]]
Koon, in his Jedi Starfighter, and his clone troopers, in their Republic Gunships, successfully destroyed the facility, freeing the enslaved Togrutan colonists, picking Kenobi, Skywalker and Tano up from the ground when they had completed their assault on the facility. After this assault, the Jedi returned back to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

====Sith Hunters====
Koon watched via holo transmission as the resurrected [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Maul sent out his communication to the Jedi on Coruscant. Maul was the Sith Lord that murdered his friend Qui-Gon Jinn [[32 BBY/Legends|over a decade]] before on Naboo. Maul [[Massacre on Raydonia/Legends|massacred]] a town on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Raydonia/Legends|Raydonia]] and threatened to do much worse if Obi-Wan Kenobi did not face him.<ref name="Sith Hunters">''[[The Clone Wars: The Sith Hunters]]''</ref>

Sometime later, Koon learned from his contacts in the Coruscant Underworld that Darth Maul and his brother Savage Opress massacred a gang of thugs in a cantina in [[Yellowblade's Landing]] on [[Orto Norwe]]. Koon traveled there with Kenobi, [[Grohto]], [[Bruu Jun-Fan]] and his Padawan [[Tatsu]] two rotations later to find mutilated bodies inside the Sith brothers' ship.<ref name="Sith Hunters" />

When Koon and the team arrived to find the Sith, they found them holding a [[Esano's sister|young female hostage]]. As part of their getaway, Maul tried to distract the Jedi by freeing a pack of wampas from their cage, thus distracting the strike team. Two clone troopers were killed in the resulting skirmish, but Masters Grohto and [[Ko Solok]] and Padawan Tatsu intercepted the Sith. Tatsu was injured and Kenobi was Force choked by Maul briefly, and he was saved by Grohto.<ref name="Sith Hunters" />

Koon and Jun-Fan, meanwhile, continued to deal with the wampa creatures while Grohto was killed by Maul. Master Jun-Fan's abilities - after the skirmish - allowed him to see that the Sith were traveling for [[Pleem's Nexus]]. With Kenobi and Tatsu no longer on the mission due to their injuries, Koon and the others proceeded to find the Sith brothers and deal with them.<ref name="Sith Hunters" />

Koon, Jun-Fan and Solok soon confronted the two brothers on Pleem's Nexus and Koon focused on a duel with Opress. Jun-Fan and Solok, meanwhile, focused on taking down Maul. In the duel with Opress, Koon's breath mask was pulled off his face. No longer able to fight, he collapsed gasping for air. Solok was killed by Maul shortly after this and Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi arrived in their fighters, injuring Opress. As the two left, Maul killed Master Jun-Fan. Koon then tended to himself by putting the mask back and rushed to the fallen Jun-Fan, hearing his final words.<ref name="Sith Hunters" />

====Battle of Phorose====
[[File:Battle_of_Phorose.jpg|thumb|238x238px|Koon during the Battle of Phorose.]]
When the Separatists invaded [[Phorose]], the Jedi Council sent Koon and Padawans Ahsoka Tano and Barriss Offee to lead the defense of the planet. During the battle, the Padawans were ambushed by droid tri-fighters and fell in an underground temple, leading to the accidental discovery of a community of Ru. However, a group of battle droids ambushed the two Jedi and destroyed the Ru temple. After the temple's destruction, Tano and Offee decided to evacuate the remaining Ru to a safe location, far from the battle. Unfortunately, the LAAT/i gunship carrying the two Padawans and the Ru was ambushed by Vulture droids, leading to the death of the Ru, with only two Ru and the two Jedi surviving.

The battle ended with the Galactic Republic's victory, however at a great cost, as most of the Phorosian capital was destroyed in the battle and the majority of the Ru were killed.

====Kidnapped====
[[File:Mission_to_Malastare_Clone_Wars.jpg|thumb|231x231px|Koon and Tano are surrounded by battle droids shortly after rescuing the Jedi Master's rescue.|left]]
During a mission on Malastare, Koon was captured by [[Drez Unlin]] who made him his hostage, until Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan Ahsoka Tano came to their colleague's rescue. Unlin promised to release Koon if one of the two Jedi could beat him on a race, but he broke his promise after Tano did so. Unlin was ultimately neutralized by his own electroshock net during a fight with the Jedi. Once Plo Koon was freed, Unlin got transferred to the planet Coruscant by Anakin, where he would spend the rest of the war in prison.

====Temple Bombing====
{{Quote|I do not believe that Ahsoka could have fallen so far.|Plo Koon|<ref name="TCAJ">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref>}}
[[File:TempleBombingFuneral.png|thumb|242x242px|Koon attending the funeral for the six Jedi killed in the bombing at the Jedi Temple.]]
After the Jedi Temple suffered a terrorist bombing, Koon attended the [[Funeral of the Jedi Temple bombing victims/Legends|funeral]] for the victims of the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|Bombing of the Jedi Temple Hangar]].<ref name="TJWKTM">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref> When Ahsoka Tano escaped from prison while she was under suspicion of organizing the bombing, Koon and Anakin Skywalker were assigned the task of looking for Tano in the Coruscant Underworld with search parties of clones, including Commander Wolffe and members of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]]. En route to the Underworld, they received word that Tano had been spotted heading toward [[Level 1312/Legends|Level 1312]]. As their [[Republic police gunship/Legends|Republic police gunships]] came in to land at [[Terminal 24/Legends|terminal 24]], Skywalker spotted Tano and Asajj Ventress talking, but the pair was able to escape. Later, an [[Coruscant Underworld Police|underworld police]] officer reported a disturbance on [[Level 1315/Legends|Level 1315]], and Koon arrived with Skywalker and Captain Rex to find that Tano had been discovered and [[Capture of Ahsoka Tano/Legends|stunned]] by Wolffe in a [[Abandoned munitions warehouse/Legends|warehouse]] full of [[Nano-droid/Legends|nano-droids]].<ref name="TCAJ" />

[[File:AhsokaCaught-TCAJ.png|thumb|left|265x265px|Koon and Skywalker during their search for Ahsoka Tano.]]
Koon was one of the five Jedi, along with Obi-Wan Kenobi, Ki-Adi-Mundi, Mace Windu, and Yoda, who made the decision to expel Tano from the Jedi Order for acts of treason against the Republic. He attended [[Trial of Ahsoka Tano/Legends|her trial]] in front of a military tribunal, where the charges against her were ultimately dropped after Barriss Offee confessed that she was the actual mastermind behind the bombing. Afterwards, Koon and several other Jedi masters apologized to Tano for not trusting her, and offered to accept her back into the Order, but Tano chose not to rejoin.<ref name="TWJ">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>

====Mystery ship====
[[File:Plo_Koon_with_Sifo-Dyas_lightsaber.png|right|thumb|167x167px|Koon discovers Sifo-Dyas' lightsaber.]]
Koon, Wolffe and their clone forces soon found themselves on a wasteland surrounded by a sandstorm. They were attempting to hunt down a signal in their walkers, and a clone soldier leading the approach from the outside reported the faint signal had been found. Koon and Wolffe along with other clones disembarked to find a crashed shuttle. But Koon found something - a lightsaber from the lost Jedi, Sifo-Dyas. He immediately ordered that everything be taken back to Coruscant.

===End of the war===
{{Quote|Execute Order 66.|Darth Sidious ordering Clone commanders to kill their Jedi officers|audio=ExecuteOrder66.flac|<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" />}}
After fighting during the [[Battle of Boz Pity (Clone Wars)|Battle of Boz Pity]], Koon returned to Coruscant soon after in order to complete some of his duties on the High Council. During this time, the skies of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] were filled with Separatist fighters and warships as a sneak attack on the capital fell into full swing. Taking to the skies during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|fighting]], Koon provided leadership in Coruscant's orbit as Master Kenobi and Jedi Skywalker rescued the captured Supreme Chancellor and killed Count Dooku. After the fires on Coruscant subsided, Koon was assigned to lead a [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|campaign]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], charged with maintaining control of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] purse world while Republic forces drove out the last remnants of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].

[[File:PloKoonDeath-ROTS.png|thumb|200px|The death of Plo Koon above [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]|left]]
While Plo Koon was leading clean up operations in the skies of the world, back on Coruscant Supreme Chancellor Palpatine revealed his alter ego as the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. As the Kel Dor Jedi led [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jai'galaar (clone)|Jag]] and an escorting squadron of [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]], Sidious issued [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] from Coruscant. Unaware of the danger he was in, Koon's craft was struck by a volley of laser fire as his escorts opened fire on their newly assigned target. His starboard wing in flames, the craft's engines exploded, consuming Plo Koon's body and ending his life. His crippled starfighter promptly went into a spin, clipping a spire-shaped clone staging area jutting up from the bridge city below and breaking apart, ejecting [[R4-F5/Legends|Koon's astromech droid]] in the process.<ref name="Revenge of the Sith" />

[[Casualty Report: Order 66|Official reports]] from the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] went to great care in fabricating the reasons behind Koon's execution in order to spin compelling anti-Jedi propaganda in favor of Emperor Palpatine's take over. Compiled by [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], these official documents stated that Koon's death was a result of a suicidal terrorist attack on a Neimoidian grub nursery.<ref name="Order 66" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|He said, 'My order knows of a means.' Who was he referring to?|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
During his exile on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], the deranged Knight [[Kazdan Paratus]], erected junk puppets based on members of the Jedi High Council at the end of the Clone Wars. When Sith Lord Darth Vader's secret apprentice, [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], fought against Paratus, the insane Jedi Knight used the Force to bring the puppets to life and and attack. The puppet based on Plo Koon was the first to engage him, with a [[Form V/Legends|Form V]] stance and a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] instead of a lightsaber. Like all of the puppets, however, Koon's was destroyed by the powerful assassin, who eventually struck down the crazed Jedi Knight.<ref name="TFU">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>

In [[43 ABY]], a number of young Jedi began contracting a [[Force psychosis|mysterious disease]], resulting in paranoia and the ability to use rare Force powers they would not ordinarily know. Curiously, fallen Jedi Knight [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] was known to exhibit many of the new abilities. [[Ayna-seff|One]] particular ability was revealed when [[Valin Horn]], one of the Jedi to contract the disease, was being observed and scanned by an [[electroencephaloscan]]. The device's readings showed Horn to be dead, while he was clearly still alive. [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], on a forced exile under mounting pressure on the Jedi Order, and his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], embarked on a journey to discover the causes of Solo's fall. While searching for an initial lead in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]], Jedi Master [[Cilghal]] stumbled across an obscure interview from decades before, in which Plo Koon mentioned an ability of the Baran Do similar to the one Horn exhibited. Following this discovery, the two Skywalkers traveled to Dorin to see the Baran Do Sages.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I don't believe in chance, Commander. I know if we work together, we will stay alive, and someone ''will'' find us.|Plo Koon, to Wolffe|<ref name="rm" />}}
[[File:Plo_Koon_and_Ahsoka_Tano.png|thumb|left|275px|Plo Koon and Ahsoka Tano, with whom he shared a close bond]]
Like many of his kind, Koon had a strong sense of justice. His species tended to see issues in black and white, and favored what was termed "rough justice", a method of solving disputes that, to non-[[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]], seemed overly retributive and too close to vigilantism. In his youth, Koon's Master Tyvokka said that he was "humble, polite, stubborn and difficult".

[[File:PloKoon-TCWLD.png|thumb|right|180px|Plo Koon during the Clone Wars]]
Plo Koon had a very close bond with [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], having been the Jedi that found her and brought her to the Jedi Temple, affectionately nicknaming her "Little Soka". Because of their bond, Tano was able to sense his presence after his fleet was destroyed by the ''Malevolence''. When Ahsoka was accused for [[Treason/Legends|treason]], Koon was reluctant to believe that she would betray the ways of the Jedi. However, due to the demand of the Galactic Senate and the accumulated evidence against her, Koon and the rest of the Jedi Council decided to expel Tano from the Order to stand trial before the senate, since if they had acted otherwise it would given the impression that the Jedi Order was opposed to the senate. When Ahsoka was cleared of the charges, Koon did apologize to her in the name of the Council, and called her by her nickname of "Little Soka". However, Ahsoka was deeply hurt and disappointed by the whole ordeal and chose to leave the Jedi Order, believing she could no longer trust any member of the Council, not even the Jedi who had brought her to the Temple in the first place.<ref name="TWJ" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], General Plo Koon developed an affinity for the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] under his command and often stated how their lives meant more to him than completing a mission. For instance, he questioned [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Sinker/Legends|Sinker]] about why he had no hope of being rescued. When the clone replied that it was because all clones were created to be an expendable product, General Koon firmly stated "not to me" thus showing that he felt great empathy and respect for the clones.<ref name="rm" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|My saber is ready!|Plo Koon|audio=Plosaberready.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns" />}}
[[File:PloKoon-SWFB.png|thumb|left|200px|Plo Koon was a very skilled lightsaber swordsman.]]
Plo Koon was a Jedi Master so powerful that the Sith Lord Darth Maul considered him to be one of the greatest Jedi warriors of his time, though they never dueled one another.<ref name="Shadow Hunter">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> Koon could replenish his [[Personal Force reservoir|power]] quickly,<ref name="TCWCG" /> was a master of telekinesis, and could move objects without having to face them.<ref name=":1">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> He also used a forbidden [[Force power/Legends|Force technique]] called [[Electric Judgment]]. To many Jedi, this seemed to be too close to the [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] employed by the enemies of the Jedi—the fearsome Sith Lords.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> Koon also had armored talons that were based on a traditional Kel Dor design. They were used to protect his sensitive fingertips and were also able to focus and increase the range of his Force powers.<ref name="Star Wars: Power of the Jedi">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|pack=Plo Koon (Jedi Master)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/potjplokoon.asp}}</ref>

Plo Koon possessed an extensive knowledge of the physical sciences. In particular, he used his expert knowledge of physics along with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Alter Environment|alter the environment]], such as to control the elements to try to make an attack miss him,<ref name="MotF">{{SWMiniCite|set=Masters of the Force|pack=Plo Koon, Jedi Master}}</ref> the resourceful Jedi could create small whirlwinds as well as a dense fog over a limited area and call ice.<ref name=":1" /> Koon could turn steam into a frost bridge, call fog, or make a zone so hot others fainted. If he had to, he could filter the air so that he could breathe without his mask, but this was a waste of effort so he stuck to the mask.<ref name="Star Wars: Power of the Jedi" /> An example of him using these skills was when he made clouds move to cover the movements of the Jedi during the Yinchori uprising, which also caused one of his now blinded foes to fall off an edge.<ref name="Jedi Council: Acts of War 2">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 2|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 2]]</ref> 

Working with other Jedi, he once threw a wave of power to smite [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchori]] warriors, and knocked one on his own<ref name="Jedi Council: Acts of War 3">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 3|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 3]]</ref> then again working with a Jedi, Qui-Gon, he brought down a tunnel to protect Vos and Kenobi during the Stark Hyperspace War, then tore down another after being given a moment to crush it.<ref name=":2" /> He also levitated a criminal to catch him fleeing.<ref>''[[Star Wars (1998) 16]]''</ref> While languishing in an escape pod after the ''Malevolence'' blew up his fleet, he used the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] turn around another, hoping to be able to wave hello to whoever was inside, only to find the front of the vessel had been destroyed. Despite the hardships of fighting in the void, he was able to defeat on droid with a push, use his power to move objects to maneuver a clone to outflank the droids and then pull him back to safety, and once he was not under fire, cut the ''Droch''-class boarding ship off his escape pod and sent it floating away with a thrust of the Force.<ref name="rm" /> Koon could preform a saber throw.<ref name=":3">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref> With his Jedi powers, he could strike his foes and also [[Force barrier/Legends|defend himself]] from Force attacks<ref name=":0" /> or [[Force deflection/Legends|throw them back]] at attackers or rip weapons from the hands of others.<ref name="TCWCG" /> He could also [[Magnify Senses|sharpen his senses]] and [[Enhance Attribute|improve his physical traits]],<ref name=":0" /> [[Force jump/Legends|leap high]], even over enemy base walls, and use the Force to [[Force speed/Legends|dash]] ahead into battle. Also, he defeated a spider droid with a single quick Force push.<ref name="Padawan Lost" /> Working with Ahsoka Tano, from atop a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]] they used their powers to hold the ruins of the [[Endurance/Legends|Endurance's]] bridge steady, so that the clones could rescue Anakin Skywalker and Mace Windu.<ref name="R2 Come Home" /> Soon after, he would unlock a lock with the Force, shove and pull into his arms Boba Fett, and hurl a table at a killer.<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" /> Another example of his skill with Force barriers was when he held off a snowstorm.<ref name="The Clone Wars 8">[[The Clone Wars 8|''The Clone Wars'' 8]]</ref>

In addition to the Jedi, Koon also belonged to the [[Baran Do]], a Force sect predating the Jedi from his homeworld of Dorin, as members of his family had been over the centuries. As such, he was a master of a number of their techniques, such as ''[[ayna-seff]]''.<ref name="Outcast" /> Plo Koon could use the force to be better at noticing things. He was very good at searching the light for guidance. Koon was also able to use the force technique [[malacia]], which caused his opponents to develop an overwhelming dizziness and nausea. <ref name="TCWCG2">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Once, he was able to send a [[Telepathy/Legends|message]] to his niece from across the galaxy, with the help of other Jedi and time to [[Serenity (trance)|focus deeply and utterly]] on the Force. He later did something similar to Stark, convincing him to switch sides in exchange for a pardon. Had he been closer than the hundreds of miles, he could have fully controlled Stark and made him surrender outright. Koon also could give brief orders to other Jedi and to other warriors with his mind directing the battle. The Jedi also tried to talk [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]] out of killing his enemies by exchanging thoughts.<ref name=":2">[[Star Wars (1998) 39|''Star Wars'' (1998) 39]]</ref>  He was not able to hope to do such things across the stars without help, however, but he was able to contact Ahsoka Tano when she was flying with her master nearby and give her a sense of where he was while out in the void.<ref name="rm" /> Yet, as he was slain, he was able to harness the agony and horror of Order 66 to send one last shard of telepathic contact, hurling awareness of the death order to his niece on Coruscant.<ref>''[[Purge: Seconds to Die]]''</ref> Koon used telepathy to help Secura as well as she was regaining her memories.<ref name="Star Wars 1998 38" /> He sometimes would [[Precognition/Legends|know the future]], such as when he foresaw how Stark’s forces would attack<ref name="Star Wars 1998 38" /> and his rescue form prison,<ref>''[[Republic 70]]''</ref> could [[Mind trick/Legends|affect the thoughts of others]]<ref name=":0" /> (up to making a crowd of twenty disruptive students chant that they should disperse before they hurt themselves and do so),<ref>[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 51|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 '''51''''']]</ref> [[Farsight/Legends|see far off events]], [[Force empathy/Legends|feel the emotions of others]] (which he used on Thyferra to feel Obi-Wan's fear),<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":0" /> and [[Sense Force|sense the Force and its users]].<ref name=":0">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> He in meditation with Qui-Gon Jinn and Adi Gallia, planted the thought of a swarm of ships attacking, to get a pilot to break off his assault. Koon was the most important of the three in this task.<ref name="Star Wars 1998 37">[[Star Wars (1998) 37|''Star Wars'' (1998) 37]]</ref> Koon [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] when he and his party were being watched<ref>''[[Star Wars (1998) 14]]''</ref> and Micah Giiett died.<ref>[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 4|''Jedi Council: Acts of War 4'']]</ref> He also sometimes could [[Truth-sense|know if others lied]], such as when he found that Kul Teska was being honest.<ref name=":3" /> 

Possessing great strength, Koon was a [[Martial artist/Legends|master]] of [[Unarmed combat|hand-to-hand combat]] and [[Battlemind|using the light side to fight better]].<ref name=":0" /> He was also a master of the fifth form of lightsaber combat, [[Form V/Legends|Form V/Shien]].<ref name="TFU" /><ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Master Plo was considered to be one of the most skilled swordsman in the Jedi Order, and was capable of fending off the infamous Jedi hunter Asajj Ventress while being encumbered by a broken arm. He was also trained in the use of [[Form IV/Legends|Form IV/Ataru]].<ref name="CWA">{{TCWA|Lightsaber Duel}}</ref> He was very good at deflecting blaster bolts and defending himself with a saber.<ref name="TCWCG" />

He studied [[Ground warfare/Legends|warfare]]<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> and also could use the Force to know the general moves of his enemies. He also could [[Force healing/Legends|heal]] the wounded.<ref name="Star Wars 1998 38">[[Star Wars (1998) 38|''Star Wars'' (1998) 38]]</ref> Moreover, Koon could [[Force blast|use the Force to blast]] enemies with a purple-blue attack.<ref name="Star Wars Saga">[[Star Wars (Hasbro toy line)|''Star Wars'' Hasbro toy line]]</ref> He also could Force blast a few feet outwards in all directions.<ref name="CWA" />

Koon was a skilled pilot and his piloting skills were as well known as his abilities with a lightsaber. Some people considered him to be the third best pilot in the Jedi Order after Anakin Skywalker and Saesee Tiin. Koon also had the ability to breathe and survive in space for a short period of time owing to his thick Kel Dor hide.<ref name="TCW:TVG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref><ref name="rm" /> He could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Kel Dor (language)/Legends|Kel Dor]], [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], and [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]].<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Portrayals===
[[File:Alan-PloKoon-Ruscoe_SWI117.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Alan Ruscoe, almost in character as Plo Koon.]]
Plo Koon was portrayed by [[Alan Ruscoe]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPM" /> and by [[Matt Sloan]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="aotc" /><ref name="Revenge of the Sith" /> Koon was voiced by [[Gregg Berger]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles|''Jedi Power Battles'']] and [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']],<ref name="Jedi Power Battles">[[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Jedi Power Battles'']]</ref><ref name="SW:OW" /> and by [[James Arnold Taylor]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars TV series'']].<ref name="The Clone Wars TV series">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series</ref>

===Origin of the name===
During construction and planning, Plo Koon was known as "Plonkoon", after the nickname of [[Nick Dudman]]'s son. It was amended by [[George Lucas]] before filming to "Plo Koon".<ref name="DB" />

===Lightsaber===
[[File:Ep2plokoonsaber.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Plo Koon's blue lightsaber.]]
The lightsaber wielded by Koon in ''Attack of the Clones'' is the same design as the one worn by Mace Windu in ''The Phantom Menace'' (with the exception of the radiator grooves which are blue on Plo's lightsaber). This Windu's saber was also blue in the Expanded Universe.

Based on his abilities in ''Jedi Power Battles'', it could be hypothesized that Koon utilized the [[Form V/Legends|Form V]] technique of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. However, this was never explicitly stated in any canonical source until ''The Force Unleashed'' novel was released.

In ''Jedi Power Battles'', Plo Koon wields a yellow [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which was echoed in the Plo Koon figure for Episode I, under the Power of the Jedi series. He also wields a yellow lightsaber in his appearances in ''Emissaries to Malastare'', but an orange lightsaber in ''The Stark Hyperspace War'', ''Jedi Council: Acts of War'', and ''Obsession''. The figure technically had a light greenish-yellow lightsaber but this matches the ''Jedi Power Battles'' video game closely and is probably meant to be yellow (like the ''Power of the Force 2'' Darth Vader figures having pink lightsabers instead of a true red). These two instances were contradicted by Plo's use of a blue lightsaber in ''Attack of the Clones'' and ''The Clone Wars'' TV series and a green lightsaber in the ''Republic: The Dreadnaughts of Rendili''. It is unclear if Plo Koon had other lightsabers, replaced his lightsaber, or if the color change is a case of canon contradiction. In the latter case, the film and TV series outstrip the video game, comics and toy.

[[File:Koon_nogoggles.jpg|thumb|right|170px|A model of Plo Koon without protective goggles.]]
[[Hasbro]]'s toy electronic [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] credits Plo Koon with an orange lightsaber instead of yellow, although this is likely not canon.

In some ''Revenge of the Sith'' concept art, Plo Koon is shown equipped with a twin-bladed [[lightsaber gauntlet]]. Though this weapon was not seen in the film, it may be found on [[Sideshow Collectibles]]' 1:6 scale Plo Koon figure. In design, this weapon is similar to one used by [[Uda-Khalid]], though Koon's saber gauntlet has twin green blades as opposed to Uda-Khalid's paired red blades. [http://www.sideshowtoy.com/prodblog/plokoon02.jpg] In Hasbro's The Clone Wars action figure line, Koon comes with the lightsaber gauntlet with blue blades, a blue bladed saber, and a blue bladed [[Shoto lightsaber/Legends|shoto]].

===Appearance without mask===
The official ''Star Wars'' database has an image of Plo Koon without his goggles exposing his closed eyes. The canon status of this is, however, in question, as the image appears in the Behind the Scenes section as a pre-production concept model and does not necessarily reflect the reality of the character.<ref name="DB" />

===Other appearances===
Although Plo Koon himself does not make an appearance in the GBA/DS version of the ''Revenge of the Sith'' video game, he is alluded to in one of Anakin Skywalker/Darth Vader's Force Specials, called Plo Koon's Round. Plo Koon was also the only one of the four characters whose names were used in Skywalker's Force Specials who was not a Sith Lord.
